div.head: Exports
div.p: Exports add what inline markup can't hold: the citation structure (citeStructure); annotations in the standOff (listAnnotation); relations (listRelation), each an observation or a judgement; text reuse as link groups (linkGrp); the revision history; and the records, as manuscript descriptions after the Bodleian's rules, bibliographic records and lists of persons, places, events and organizations.
